memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: These are the men the Lord commanded to assign the inheritance to the Israelites in the land of Canaan. - Num 34:29 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The chapter closes with a simple summary: these were the men the Lord commanded to assign the inheritance to Israel in Canaan. It is a short, plain verse, but it carries weight. These leaders were not self-appointed; they were commissioned by God. Their authority to divide the land came not from their own ambition but from the command of the Lord. They were doing God's work in God's way, by God's appointment.

There is something steadying about serving under a clear commission from God. These men did not have to wonder whether their task was legitimate or whether they had the right to do it. God had commanded it. They could carry out their responsibility with confidence, knowing they were acting under His authority, not their own.

We serve under a commission too. Before Jesus ascended, He gave His followers their great task: to go and make disciples of all nations, baptising and teaching them (Matt 28:19-20). We do not serve God on our own initiative or authority; we serve because the risen Lord has sent us. And He did not send us alone — He promised, "Surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age."

Whatever God has called you to do, you can do it with the quiet confidence of one who is commissioned. You are not making up your own mission; you are joining the work God has appointed and empowered. The One who commands the task also equips and accompanies those who carry it out. Go and serve, resting in His authority and His abiding presence.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you serve God with the confidence of one who is commissioned by Him?
2. How does the Great Commission shape your sense of purpose?
3. What comfort do you find in Jesus' promise to be with you always?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord Jesus, thank You that You commission and send Your people, and that You promise to be with us always. Help me to serve with confidence under Your authority, carrying out the work You have given me. Amen.
